up: Retrieve distinct compounds from document CHEMBL5726160. Return the ChEMBL ID, the preferred name of the compound, and the canonical SMILES string for each compound. Join the document table to the compound records to filter by the document ID, and then join to the molecule dictionary for the name and to the compound structures for the SMILES. Do not apply any other filters or ranking limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726160'
